Source contracts: src/smto_skill_sdk

src/smto_skill_sdk/init.py

Python · Tier A

Public, runtime-independent Python interfaces for SMTO user skills.

Details

Only JSON contract data crosses the process boundary. Skills own their external configuration and effects; SMTO owns authorization and execution receipts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
SkillDescriptor 20 Stable package identity and model-visible explanation.
ToolDescriptor 31 One tool's JSON contracts, effect and execution mode.
SkillResult 44 A returned observation; errors never imply that no effect occurred.
JobSnapshot 52 Observed durable work. Unknown liveness must not release ownership. States are queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, or unknown. Terminal states require active=False. A cancellation request alone is not that evidence.
LogPage 68 Bounded UTF-8 job output with a monotonically advancing byte cursor.
SkillContext 77 Invocation identity and local lifecycle controls, never runtime access. Persist job identity/provider mappings under state_dir before acknowledging a launch. Configuration and credentials must come from author-managed sources.
SkillContext.job_id 91 Return the runtime-assigned launch identity.
IUnknownV1 96 COM-inspired interface negotiation with Python-owned references.
IUnknownV1.query_interface 99 Return this canonical object for implemented interfaces, else None.
ISkillV1 106 Mandatory interface. Descriptions must be deterministic and side-effect free.
ISkillV1.describe 110 Describe this installed package.
ISkillV1.list_tools 114 Return the fixed tool contracts for this package revision.
ISkillV1.initialize 118 Open local resources for a worker; do not start business operations.
ISkillV1.invoke 122 Execute one authorized synchronous tool call.
ISkillV1.shutdown 126 Release the worker's control resources, without abandoning durable jobs.
IJobSkillV1 130 Optional durable-job controls, callable after a new worker is created.
IJobSkillV1.start_job 134 Start once under context.job_id and durably retain its provider identity.
IJobSkillV1.get_job 138 Recover the existing job's observed state; never restart work.
IJobSkillV1.cancel_job 142 Request cancellation and report observed liveness.
IJobSkillV1.read_job_logs 146 Read existing output, or return an empty page when none is available.
contract 150 Check Python interface conformance and serialize descriptors. The controller separately validates JSON Schemas, package identity and reserved names before publishing any tools. This function never initializes the skill.

src/smto_skill_sdk/main.py

Python · Tier A

SDK command line: validate interfaces in a child process or build the SDK wheel.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
main 11 Validate without installing dependencies; skill imports execute trusted code.

src/smto_skill_sdk/wheel.py

Python · Tier A

Build a pure-Python SDK wheel using only the standard library.

Details

Releases carry this wheel as a data resource, allowing an offline Hello World installation without exposing compiled controller modules to skill environments.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
build_wheel 17 Write a standalone SDK wheel and its complete RECORD hashes.

src/smto_skill_sdk/worker.py

Python · Tier A

Private SDK worker: import user code only here and serve bounded JSON IPC.

Details

Stdout is reserved before importing the skill; Python and native print output is redirected to stderr. A reader remains responsive to cooperative cancellation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
main 30 Run one skill instance; EOF ends control work, never relaunching jobs.
